items.h: Max Hurleman signs with Steelers active roster
items.s: The Steelers signed WR Max Hurleman to their active roster. Hurleman will continue to add depth in the wide receiver room for Pittsburgh.

The Steelers signed Hurleman off the practice squad to the active roster Thursday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports. The move corresponds with the Steelers placing Ben Skowronek (calf) on injured reserve. Hurleman was called up from the practice squad and made his NFL regular-season debut against the Eagles in Week 11, when he caught six of seven targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in a 19-16 loss for the Steelers. He also returned three punts for 36 yards and two kickoffs for 32 yards, and with Skowronek on IR, Hurleman figures to take on more return duties moving forward. Hurleman reverted to the Steelers' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log. With DK Metcalf ejected in the second half of Sunday's loss to the Eagles, Hurleman ended up playing 22 of 71 offensive snaps in his regular-season NFL debut. The undrafted rookie ended up seeing seven targets and caught six of them for 61 yards and the Steelers' lone touchdown of the contest. He also handled two kick returns and returned a trio of punts.

items.h: Max Hurleman shines in career debut
items.s: Max Hurleman caught six passes for 61 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's loss to the Eagles. Hurleman was brought up from the practice squad to aid the Steelers' wide receiver room. With that opportunity, Hurleman lead the team in receptions, yards, and scored the only touchdown for the Steelers. However, he may revert back to the practice squad, so he won't be a viable play in Week 12's game against the Broncos.

items.h: Late TD among six catches in debut
items.s: Hurleman caught six of seven targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles. He also had two kickoff returns for 32 yards and three punt returns for 36 yards. Hurleman unexpectedly emerged as Aaron Rodgers' go-to target during Pittsburgh's fourth-quarter comeback bid after DK Metcalf was disqualified. The practice squad elevation put an exclamation point on his NFL debut with a 20-yard touchdown catch with 1:21 left in the fourth quarter. The Steelers elevated Hurleman from the practice squad Saturday. With Michael Pittman (foot) remaining on injured reserve and Roman Wilson (finger) officially listed as questionable, Hurleman is up as the Steelers' sixth receiver. He's never appeared in a regular-season NFL game.
The Steelers elevated WR Max Hurleman for Sunday's game against the Eagles. Hurleman will add depth in the wide receiver room for Pittsburgh.

The Steelers activated Hurleman (undisclosed) from the practice squad injured list Wednesday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports. Hurleman landed on the practice squad IL in mid-September due to an undisclosed injury. The Notre Dame product is now fully healthy, and he would be a candidate for elevation to the Steelers' active roster if the team needs more depth at running back. Hurleman has yet to play in a regular-season game since entering the NFL in May of 2025 as an undrafted free agent.

items.h: Placed on practice squad injured reserve
items.s: The Steelers placed Hurleman (undisclosed) on practice squad injured reserve Saturday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports. Hurleman signed with the Steelers' practice squad Sept. 2. The wide receiver has suffered an undisclosed injury and will now need to miss four games before he is eligible to return to the 16-man practice squad.

items.h: Catches on with Pittsburgh's practice squad
items.s: The Steelers signed Hurleman to the practice squad Monday. The Steelers waived Hurleman during Sunday's cutdown day. The wide receiver cleared waivers and will once again sign with the practice squad. Hurleman spent the entirety of the 2025 season on the Steelers' practice squad but did not participate in any regular-season games.
